findings.title: Design Plan Document Truncated
findings.description: design-plan.md exceeds 250KB or 2000-line platform limit; content cut off mid-section (ends at line 830). Verify full document exists; if truncated by platform, split into separate files (design-plan-1.md, design-plan-2.md) or request limit increase.

findings.title: Form Component Library Not Specified
findings.description: component-api.md lists planned form components (TextInput, TextArea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, DatePicker, FileUpload) but provides no specifications: no props tables, state definitions, accessibility requirements, or usage examples. AddListingPage and all forms depend on these.
findings.action: Create form-components.md with full specifications for all form components before implementation

findings.title: PriceInput & PhoneInput Specifications Incomplete
findings.description: Both components listed as 'Planned' with minimal details. Missing: validation rules (min/max/format), currency switching behavior (SDG/EGP/AED), phone country code detection logic, error states, and recovery flows.
findings.action: Expand PriceInput and PhoneInput specifications with validation rules, currency/country logic, and edge cases

findings.title: MediaUploader Specification Minimal
findings.description: Component listed as planned with basic props only. Missing: concurrent upload limits, client-side compression rules, retry strategy details, progress bar UX (cumulative vs. per-file), and max file count per listing.
findings.action: Expand MediaUploader specification with backend integration requirements and error handling scenarios

findings.title: Sudan Cities/Areas Not Defined
findings.description: component-api.md LocationPicker specified as cascade dropdown for Sudan cities/areas but no actual geography data provided (e.g., Khartoum → Jabrein, Shambat, etc.). Cannot test implementation without real data.
findings.action: Define complete Sudan city/area hierarchy (at least 5 major cities with sub-areas) in separate data file

findings.title: Image Size Presets Inconsistent Between Documents
findings.description: performance-strategy.md specifies 'Grid: 300×225px, Detail: 800×600px' while image-strategy.md specifies 'card: 400×300, detail: 800×600, detail-lg: 1200×900'. Two different presets defined; unclear which is authoritative.
findings.action: Use image-strategy.md as authoritative; update performance-strategy.md to reference image preset table

findings.title: CDN Infrastructure Marked TBD
findings.description: image-strategy.md lists 'TBD' for image storage location, CDN endpoint, and geo-distribution. Cannot verify performance targets or estimate costs without this infrastructure specification.
findings.action: Backend team must specify: image storage (S3/GCS/NFS?), CDN provider (CloudFront/Bunny/Local?), and regional edge locations for Sudan before implementation

findings.title: Border Radius RTL Support Incomplete
findings.description: Tailwind v3 does not support logical corner radius tokens (rounded-ss, rounded-ee). design-tokens.md acknowledges limitation but RTL-i18n-guide.md doesn't provide clear workaround. In RTL, corners won't mirror properly with physical properties.
findings.action: Choose: (1) upgrade to Tailwind v4, (2) implement CSS variable workaround with [dir] selector, or (3) accept physical properties limitation and document it

findings.title: Network Probe Endpoint Not Owned
findings.description: weak-internet-ux.md requires /api/probe endpoint (1KB file for network speed detection) but provides no backend specification. No clarity on response format, status codes, or error handling.
findings.action: Add backend spec: 'GET /api/probe returns 1KB JSON (e.g., {ok: true}); Cache-Control: no-cache'

findings.title: Prefetch Strategy Ignores Language Parameter
findings.description: performance-strategy.md prefetch examples use queryKey: ['search', 'cars'] but ignore language. In RTL/Arabic context, ['search', 'cars'] vs. ['search', 'سيارات'] are different queries. Must include language.
findings.action: Update all prefetch examples: queryKey should include language parameter, e.g., ['search', 'cars', lang]

findings.title: Cache Invalidation Strategy Not Fully Integrated
findings.description: performance-strategy.md defines cache TTLs, weak-internet-ux.md specifies draft persistence, component-api.md doesn't address cache updates on server changes. No unified strategy for when to invalidate listings, profile, or listing detail caches.
findings.action: Create unified cache invalidation document showing: (1) user updates listing → invalidate which caches, (2) WebSocket message arrives → update which caches, (3) payment processed → refresh which user data
